sampling: Paired iid uniform draws inside declared parameter ranges. Not experimental confidence intervals. No aggregate score across conflicting objectives.
scope_note: Twelve selected parameters including conductivity solid-fraction exponent, liquid-volume gain and quartz transition eigenstrain sampled in declared assumed ranges. Permeability remains fixed at its nominal value after two cost-limited broad-permeability attempts. All other parameters fixed except scenario controls. Results apply only to this constitutive closure and selected ranges; they do not prove permeability-range robustness, all-parameter robustness or measured material validity. Prior nine- and ten-parameter ensembles remain historical.
limitation: Small sample ensemble is exploratory. Wilson bounds explicitly prevent calling a small unanimous sample a proven robust ranking.
